Titel: Interim Corporate Controller (6-month contract)
Unternehmen: Lakeshore Components Inc.
Ort: Chicago, IL (Vereinigte Staaten)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4200001107/
Abgerufen am: 15.09.2026 07:30

About Lakeshore
Lakeshore Components is a privately held manufacturer of hydraulic parts with 1,200 employees and plants in Illinois and Ohio. Following the acquisition of a German subsidiary, we need an experienced interim controller.

The role
Lead the month-end close and consolidated financial reporting under US GAAP, including the IFRS reconciliation for the German entity
Integrate the German subsidiary into group reporting
Support the SAP S/4HANA rollout across both plants
Prepare board packages and lender reporting

Qualifications
CPA or equivalent, German Wirtschaftsprüfer or Steuerberater welcome
10+ years in controlling and consolidation, ideally in manufacturing
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and Power BI
German language skills are a strong plus

Compensation and location
Hourly rate USD 150 to 185, W-2 or 1099
Fully on site at our Chicago headquarters, Monday to Friday
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States, no visa sponsorship
